The '''''Fire Lotus''-class starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] fielded by [[Grace Command]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Characteristics==
''Fire Lotus''-class starfighters were big, heavy starfighters that were capable of traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. They had a series of large foils that were arranged as a "shield blossom" around four rear engines. These foils helped shield the starfighter from incoming enemy fire from behind. This design also protected the pilot's compartment during dogfights.<ref name="Faraway-Star Wars: Knight Errant – Deluge #2">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknighterrantdeluge/swknighterrantdeluge2.html|text=Star Wars: Knight Errant &ndash; Deluge #2}}</ref>

==History==
The ships were donated by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Lemayne]] and operated outside of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] who had yet to gain access to the fighter. Most of its pilots were ex-Navy personnel in Grace Command. They supported the relief efforts of Grace Command attacking [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces and escorting transports like ''[[Mother Grace]]''.<ref name="Deluge 1" /><ref name="Deluge 2" />
